title: Guacamole
summary: Chunky, bright and done in fifteen minutes. No stove needed.

steps.text: Finely dice the red onion and let it soak in the juice of the lime.
steps.check: onion diced small, sitting in lime juice

steps.text: Halve the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
steps.check: avocado flesh in bowl, no pits

steps.text: Mash the avocado with a fork, leaving it a bit chunky.
Dice the tomato and jalapeño and chop the cilantro.
Fold everything in with the salt, then taste and adjust lime and salt.
Let it sit so the flavors come together.
